name: Kujou Shiori
source: Raped again and again and again for days and nights without end her health is failing. Fearing that only death awaits her she prays that her sister [url=https://vndb.org/c22924]Akane[/url] can find her and rescue her from this hell.
translation: 她日夜不停地被一次又一次强奸，健康状况正在恶化。她害怕等待自己的只有死亡，便祈求姐姐[url=https://vndb.org/c22924]茜[/url]能找到她，把她从这个地狱中救出去。
